note: The attacker cost constants are STIPULATED GUESSES. Coverage is reported AS A RANGE across the 0.33x/1x/3x mule-cost sweep because the constants shape the archive; the solvent-only range shows how many cells' attacks stop being economically viable as mule cost rises. Ruin is a flag, never a deletion, so cells persist and a number moves instead of a cell emptying.
reduced_form_caveat: This re-prices the seed population at each multiplier rather than re-running sim+train+eval three times (the hours-scale full path). It shows the direction and magnitude of the economic sensitivity, which is the sweep's purpose.
